description: Check a number before tracking it: is it a container (ISO 6346 check digit), bill of lading or booking number, and which carrier issued it. Stores nothing and needs no company. Use it when the user is unsure what a number is; track_shipment detects on its own. Required: reference (3-64 characters, e.g. MSCU1234566). Returns: reference, ref_type, carrier_scac, carrier_name, confidence, check_digit_valid, note, suggested_carrier.

reference.description: Container, bill of lading or booking number.

name: detect_reference
title: Detect reference
